name: BSP_LuaGame_EndScene
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol; the Lua name is recovered. Packet cc_exe_2g, read-only analysis. __fastcall(LuaState*) -> int returning 0, body 008b01b0-008b0465. Registered as the Lua global 'EndScene' (the 560-row binding table of 006b8610; src/mission_lua_host.cpp row {EndScene, 008b01b0}). It reads the commit slot's scoring record at [00e188a8+21A0h] + 4 + [[..+21A0h]+1424h]*284h: when that record's +0h (mission_completed_00) is clear AND the session is single player ([game+1FE4h] == 0) it tests 007f8d60 and raises a menu prompt through BSP_MenuPromptScreen_Raise 00531b00 with 00530670 or 00530c20, returning WITHOUT ending the scene; otherwise it calls BSP_Game_EndScene 004d7970. Scripts/global/commandhelpers.lua reaches it as luaDelay(EndScene, 12) from luaMissionCompleted_ComplText when the mission has no completion movie, so a script must call Scoring_SetMissionCompleted before ending a mission this way. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md, docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2g correction 9.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_MissionNarrative
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. lua_CFunction __fastcall(lua_State* in ECX), RET 0, returns 0 as a literal. Rows 00E0C190 and 00E0C198 both point here, under MissionNarrative and MissionNarrativeEnqueue; the handler cannot tell them apart for the same reason as 00896A90. It uses the descriptor path 006B7E30 / 008875F0 / 00887120(-1,4) rather than the LuaStateOwner frame, reads argument 1 as a string from descriptor+1Ch and any further arguments through 006EDF00 at stride 14h, and calls 00734870 with descriptor+8h, the string and the vector. docs/LUA_BINDING_ALIASES.md.

name: BSP_LuaScoring_SetMissionCompleted
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Lua binding registered at 00e0c380 as {00d0f52c 'Scoring_SetMissionCompleted', 008b8ad0}; the body carries the literal 'luaMW_Scoring_SetMissionCompleted failed:'. __fastcall(LuaState*) -> int, RET at 008b8c9f. 008b8bad..008b8c42 resolves the slot: default game+18ECh, and in modes other than 0 the first Lua argument is read as the slot with the boolean shifted to position 1; completed defaults to true. Calls 00906460 with ECX = [game+21A0h]. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_ScoringIsUnlocked
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol; the error literal in the body is "luaMW_Scoring_IsUnlocked failed:". Reads argument 0 as a Lua string, wraps it with BSP_NativeString_Assign and returns 007FC4C0's result to Lua, so Scoring_IsUnlocked is the script-side name of the unlock predicate. Shipped mission scripts call it with medal ids: IsUnlocked("JM2_GOLD"), IsUnlocked("JM6_SILVER"), IsUnlocked("JM6_BRONZE"). See docs/PROFILE_UNLOCK_PREDICATE.md.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_GunForceFire
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. lua_CFunction for the GunForceFire row of the mission binding table 00E0B7B8. Argument 0 is a gun, not a unit: the shipped scripts pass GetGun(unit, n), and the handle arrives through 00888D20 BSP_LuaTable_GetPtrField at 008BE540 rather than the entity resolver. Sets every barrel timer to 0.0f with 0072CF00 at 008BE56B over gun[448h], then calls gun vtable[1D8h] (00730160) at 008BE5AD with (1, gun+400h throwA, gun+404h throwB). docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_GunForceFireWithAngle

name: BSP_LuaBinding_HasFired
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. lua_CFunction for the HasFired row of 00E0B7B8. Shipped scripts call it as HasFired(unit, weaponName, window). Tests the entity with vtable[5Ch], fetches the weapon director through vtable[114h] (0080E150) and falls back to the owner at unit+9D4h when that is null, then asks 006E8250(director, name, window) and pushes the boolean. The fallback gate was read from pseudocode only and 006E8250 is unread. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_GetShipTorpedoes
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. lua_CFunction for the GetShipTorpedoes row of 00E0B7B8. Returns a new Lua table of the live torpedo entities owned by the unit. Reads the projectile registry at (00E188A8)+19CCh, count at +21Ch and list head at +224h, each node carrying the entity at +8h, and keeps those whose +5Eh is zero and whose +3BCh owner is the argument entity. This is the live projectile list, not the unit's weapon devices. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md.
